title: YYYY Subdivision of UNIT (Voting Districts)
description: Boundaries of voting districts in UNIT following the YYYY delimitation and accompanying subdivision exercise.
methodology: A detailed accounting of the methodology will be provided by Thevananthan et. al in mid-July 2026. However, the compilaton and validation process is essentially identical to that documented in [Thevananthan and Chacko (2025)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.24211); the work on DMs is an extension of the prior work on Parliament and DUN constituencies.

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [String] State in which the parliamentary constituency is located, e.g. 'Perlis'

fields.name: parlimen
fields.title: Parliament
fields.description: [String] Code (P.xxx) and name of the parliamentary constituency, e.g. 'P.001 Padang Besar'

fields.name: code_parlimen
fields.title: Parliament Code
fields.description: [String] Official code of the parliamentary constituency, e.g. 'P.001'

fields.name: dun
fields.title: DUN
fields.description: [String] Code (N.xx) and name of the DUN constituency, e.g. 'N.01 Titi Tinggi'

fields.name: code_dun
fields.title: DUN Code
fields.description: [String] Official code of the DUN constituency, e.g. 'N.01'

fields.name: dm
fields.title: Voting District
fields.description: [String] Code (xxx/yy/zz) and name of the Voting District, e.g. '001/01/01 Jalan Padang Besar'

fields.name: code_dm
fields.title: Voting District Code
fields.description: [String] Official code of the Voting District, e.g. '001/01/01'

cite.instructions: Users wishing to reference this dataset in an academic context should (for now) cite Thevananthan (2026). The citation will be updated in October when a new preprint is published.
cite.title: Map of the Subdivision of Voting Districts
